purpose: Qualify temporal phylogenetic geometry for the independent trait-memory spectrum without changing the already-observed design-gate behavior of overlapping systems.
overlap_rule: If family x trait is present in results/bien_temporal_informativeness_v0_4_2/temporal_informativeness.csv, reuse that frozen PASS/HOLD result exactly; do not rerun with a different seed or calibration.
novel_system_rule: Only systems not previously evaluated are simulated, using the identical inherited contract.
